title: EOS venture policy
description: Per-venture routing and control policy. Path pattern lists are signal sources that activate named factors; no rule maps a path alone to a tier. Content under the pointers named in protected_pointers is part of the protected set: changing it requires an accepted ADR and the operator. See kernel/POLICY_SPEC.md for the law this file instantiates.

version.description: Policy version. Routing is deterministic given the same facts and this version.

capability_profile.description: Repo-relative path or id of the capability-profile record (capability-profile.schema.json) this policy binds to. Profile level tunes Express thresholds, the free band and review sampling, never tier floors.

risk.description: The factor table binding. Protected content: changes require an accepted ADR.

path_patterns.description: Signal sources only. A pattern match activates the factors whose sources cite its class (paths:reversible, paths:sensitive, paths:protected); a pattern never carries a tier itself.

express.description: Express (R0) admission thresholds. Exceeding a size threshold denies R0; it never raises a floor by itself.

denied_by_factors.description: Factor ids whose activation denies Express regardless of size.

decision_budget.description: Decision bands: free (decide, record in the commit message), durable (decide, short ADR before merge), escalation (never alone).

approvals.description: Protected content: changes require an accepted ADR.

always_human.description: Factor or guarded-action-class ids that always require a human decision. The guard's non-waivable floors apply on top and cannot be removed here.

adapter.description: Host enforcement adapter id, for example claude-code.

mapping_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the adapter mapping (permission rules and hooks per guarded class).

validated.description: True only when the named adapter passed the bypass suite and the validation report is committed. Absent or false fails closed: every guarded class is manual-only.

items.description: RFC 6901 JSON pointer into this document.

protected_pointers.description: JSON pointers whose content is protected. Must include /risk and /approvals. The list is a declaration and no command reads it to rule a touch: what enforces the protected set is python -m tools.eos route, which exits 3 when the diff matches a pattern in risk.path_patterns.protected and no --adr was given. See kernel/POLICY_SPEC.md.

denies_express.description: When true, an active instance of this factor denies R0 regardless of tier_floor (boundary contact, size thresholds).

sources.description: Signal source ids that can activate this factor: declared side-effect names, derived detector ids, or path classes (paths:reversible, paths:sensitive, paths:protected).

artefacts.description: Artefacts the mode requires. Express lists commit-message only.

test_timing.description: per-profile defers to the capability profile default set by the test-timing ablation.
